summary: Klarna Group plc filed a Form 6-K on August 18, 2026, furnishing its second quarter 2026 earnings release, investor presentation, interim condensed consolidated financial statements, and supplementary metrics. The filing reports operational and financial results, including GMV of $36.6 billion, revenue of $1.042 billion, and adjusted operating income of $91 million. This is a routine earnings disclosure by a foreign private issuer, containing no transactional elements, strategic alternatives, or special-situation events. The exhibits are incorporated by reference into the company's Form S-8 registration statement. No special-situation category applies.
